description: **Rule A clears on a round that no longer exists at the head**: `warscape/policy.py` `round_problems` looks up `opened`, built from every commit of review.md's history, and never asks whether that round survived; add the condition `k in head_r` and a test on a real repository (R1 writes `merge` and code, a side branch writes round 2, a trailerless `git merge -s ours` drops it: rule A says nothing at `error`) Why: it passes the real verb, though no honest flow reaches it: the commit-msg hook refuses that merge, and forging a visible round is easier Raised: W40 review round 2 Later 1, 2026-11-05
title: Rule A clears on a round that no longer exists at the head
